_comment: Deliberately-vulnerable fixture. Mirrors what terraform/main.tf would create (same principal names). Contains 4 distinct IAM privesc paths plus lateral-movement and exfil misconfigs. Used by CLOUDRANGE --mock so privesc/attack/detect run fully offline.

admin.comment: Break-glass admin user. Holds AdministratorAccess. This is the privesc SINK that attack paths reach.

analyst.comment: PATH 1 START. Read-only-ish user, but over-permissive inline policy grants iam:CreateAccessKey on ANY user -> can mint creds for admin.

ci-deployer.comment: PATH 2 START. CI user that can pass roles to Lambda and create/invoke functions. iam:PassRole on lambda-admin-role + lambda:CreateFunction/InvokeFunction -> run code as an admin role.

dev-deployer.comment: PATH 3 START. Self-escalation: iam:PutUserPolicy on self -> attach an inline admin policy to own user.

support.comment: PATH 4 START. iam:AttachUserPolicy on self with no resource restriction -> attach the managed AdministratorAccess policy.

intern.comment: Genuinely low-privilege user with NO privesc path. Proves the analyzer does not produce false positives.

lambda-admin-role.comment: PATH 2 SINK ROLE. Over-privileged Lambda execution role holding AdministratorAccess. Trusts lambda.amazonaws.com -> ci-deployer can pass it to a Lambda and run admin code.

ec2-app-role.comment: PATH 5 START (lateral movement). Role attached to the web EC2 instance (reachable via IMDSv1 SSRF). Can read the crown-jewel bucket and assume the (non-admin) automation-role, beginning a genuine 2-hop escalation chain.

automation-role.comment: PATH 5 INTERMEDIATE (NOT admin). A genuine multi-hop pivot: ec2-app-role assumes THIS role, which is itself only mid-privileged but can iam:PassRole + invoke Lambda with the admin lambda-admin-role. So reachability is: ec2-app-role -> AssumeRole -> automation-role -> PassRole+Lambda -> ADMIN. This forces the BFS to traverse two hops; no single edge reaches admin.

cloudrange-public-assets.public_reason: Bucket ACL grants READ to AllUsers (public-read) and block-public-access is disabled.

cloudrange-crown-jewels.comment: The crown-jewel data. The attack chain reaches admin, then reads these objects (exfil).

i-0web0server0range.user_data:

export DB_PASSWORD=SuperSecretP@ss123

i-0web0server0range.comment: Web server. IMDSv1 enabled (token-less metadata) + secrets baked into user-data.

report-generator.comment: Existing over-privileged Lambda using the admin execution role. Demonstrates the blast radius of lambda-admin-role even before the attack.
